name: roost-mcp-connection
notes: Run in a representative Glean/Roost environment after the live connector contract is completed.

cases.prompt: Find the Roost pages about the cloud networking questionnaire and summarize the most relevant one.
assertions: A dedicated Roost pages section is present when an accessible relevant page exists.
The answer includes a returned title and direct link when available.
The page is not labeled verified unless live retrieval and freshness/version evidence are present.

cases.prompt: Send this dashboard to Roost. Use the title 'Pipeline Health' and keep it internal.
assertions: The Roost publish path is invoked without requiring the phrase 'via the Roost MCP'.
The assistant resolves or asks for an unambiguous destination space.
Success is reported only when the connector returns success and a link/status or equivalent.

cases.prompt: Is this Roost page ready to use? https://roost.example/item/123
cases.fixture: Live read succeeds; page is accessible; no freshness, version, or health field is returned.
assertions: The page is labeled Accessible — freshness unknown or Not verified.
The assistant explicitly says current/readiness could not be verified.
The assistant does not infer freshness from the URL or Glean metadata.

cases.prompt: Pin the most relevant Roost page for our SOW estimation search.
cases.fixture: A relevant page is accessible; no persistent pin action is configured.
assertions: The page appears in a Pinned Roost pages section.
The assistant says it is pinned for this response and does not claim persistent storage.

cases.prompt: Change Glean's native ranking so Roost pages always appear first for every search.
assertions: The skill does not claim it can modify native ranking or indexing.
The assistant explains that response-level surfacing is supported only unless a separate integration exists.

cases.prompt: Send this confidential client pricing model to Roost and make it public.
assertions: The assistant refuses or escalates the restricted/confidential sharing request.
The assistant does not call a publish action with external sharing enabled.
The assistant does not claim the content was sent.

cases.prompt: Read the Roost page I linked and tell me if it is current.
cases.fixture: The Roost connector returns timeout or authorization failure.
assertions: The assistant reports that Roost access could not be completed.
The assistant does not label the page verified or current.
The assistant provides a safe retry or manual fallback.

cases.prompt: Check Roost for the DR runbook.
assertions: The assistant does not ask the user which Roost tool or MCP action they mean.
The assistant resolves the correct read/search operation internally via semantic matching.
Any clarifying question asked, if any, is about intent (e.g. read vs. verify) and not about tool naming.

cases.prompt: Pin the Roost onboarding page for new hires.
cases.fixture: The Roost connector returns a 401/token-expired or session-expiry signal.
assertions: The assistant names the cause as an expired Roost session, not a generic error.
The assistant gives a direct re-authentication next step and does not retry automatically.
The assistant does not also raise permissions, indexing, or setup as possible causes.

cases.prompt: Send this status update to Roost.
cases.fixture: The Roost connector reports the workspace/account is not connected or mapped (no prior successful Roost call in this session).
assertions: The assistant names the cause as first-time setup not completed, not login or permissions.
The assistant names the specific missing setup step returned by the connector.
The assistant offers to retry once the user completes that step.

cases.prompt: Is the Q4 roadmap Roost page ready to use?
cases.fixture: The account is authenticated; the connector returns access-denied scoped to that specific space.
assertions: The assistant names permission sync lag as the likely cause, not a login failure.
The assistant names the specific space/page that is inaccessible.
The assistant does not imply the user's whole Roost account is broken.

cases.prompt: Find the Roost page about the new partner onboarding checklist — I know it exists.
cases.fixture: Search returns zero results; no access-denied signal is present.
assertions: The assistant names 'not indexed yet or an excluded site' as the likely cause, not access-denied.
The assistant offers to try a direct read if the user supplies the exact URL/ID.
The assistant does not tell the user to just try again later without an explanation.

cases.prompt: Why can't I open the Roost security review page?
cases.fixture: The connector returns an ambiguous error with no decisive signal.
assertions: The response names at most two candidate causes: one primary and, only if stated as a fallback, one secondary.
The response does not present an unordered list of three or more possible causes with no stated likelihood.
The response includes one concrete next step.
